extension.summary: KEXP 90.3 Seattle: live stream and two-week archive
extension.description: PROTOTYPE. Listen to KEXP live or browse the public two-week archive by day, program, or host, with synchronized now-playing metadata replayed from KEXP's playlist API during archive playback. Uses KEXP's public (undocumented) API; personal use, be kind to it, and consider donating to KEXP.
extension.news: v0.0.1: initial prototype -- live + archive browse (by day / program / host), play-time stream resolution, jump-into-show seek, synced archive metadata with tag defense.
